blind.description: A freestanding section of straight stone masonry wall, constructed from weathered green-grey rectangular stone blocks with an inset horizontal relief slot/brick in the center. The top is finished with an overhanging, bevelled coping stone split into two halves. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with slight rounded bevels between blocks, sitting flush on the floor without an added base.
blind.from_above: A slender elongated rectangle with rounded corners, split down the middle by a seam into two rectangular capstone slabs.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.4 times the height of the figure (around 8 feet tall) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide across the face.
blind.material_and_color: Aged, mossy greenish-grey stone masonry with subtle vertical water streaks and weathering.

notes: wall solid: w:h 0.48, depth:h 0.11, largest opening 6% x 1%, filled 98%
